cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's accounting machine reconcile the company card statement for HANGS Construction.
First it checks that the statement adds up, card by card, and ties last month's payment to the ledger.
Next it matches every charge to its expense line and its receipt.
One charge went through twice, and a hotel bill has no receipt.
And a software renewal was never approved.
Next it codes each charge by what was bought, and catches use tax: tax owed on goods shipped from out of state.
Then it codes the whole statement to the ledger, and drafts five requests for a person to send.
About $1,600 is held for a decision, until receipts and approvals arrive.
All done. The statement ties to the cent, with six exceptions and five requests drafted. Nothing was posted or sent; the controller approves every entry and request.
Jumping to the results. A person still reviews every item before anything is posted, paid or sent.
